title: Implement Asteroid Entity and Spawning System
description: Create the asteroid entity system supporting random trajectory generation, variable sizes, and split-on-impact mechanics. Include unit tests for collision bounding boxes and asteroid generation logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Asteroid spawner generates entities at canvas boundaries with velocities directed inward
Large asteroids split into smaller child asteroids upon receiving damage
reviewFeedback: The asteroid entity and spawning system implementation is clean, modular, immutable, and properly tested. Vector math, screen wrapping via modulo offset ranges, collision checks, and splitting mechanics are correctly implemented.
